entities.name: Q9ZBL1 HMP kinase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match: 279 residues, 100% identity and coverage; reviewed Mycobacterium leprae protein.
Catalyzes phosphorylation of hydroxymethylpyrimidine (HMP) to HMP-phosphate and HMP-phosphate to HMP-diphosphate.
Annotated EC 2.7.1.49 and EC 2.7.4.7; cytosolic thiamine diphosphate biosynthesis enzyme.
Pfam evidence for Phos_pyr_kin domain positions 23–272 and PfkB domain positions 130–252 in the query sequence.

entities.name: HMP + ATP -> HMP-P + ADP
observations: 4-amino-5-hydroxymethyl-2-methylpyrimidine is phosphorylated to 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(phosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine using ATP, producing ADP and H+. Rhea RHEA:23096; EC 2.7.1.49.

entities.name: HMP-P + ATP -> HMP-PP + ADP
observations: 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(phosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine is phosphorylated to the diphosphate using ATP, producing ADP. Rhea RHEA:19893; EC 2.7.4.7.

entities.name: Thiamine diphosphate biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme performs steps 2/3 and 3/3 in formation of the diphosphomethylpyrimidine moiety of thiamine diphosphate.
